correctness.summary: A self-contained blockwise case analysis proves weight at least 6 for both the subdivided claw and the triangularized claw whenever only the root has external neighbors. Explicit weight-6 labelings survive arbitrary positive-root gluing, giving equality globally. Degree-two counts prove that every mixed construction containing a triangularized block lies outside the standard rooted-product family.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The 2017 paper proposes subdivided-claw rooted products as the equality class accompanying its open 6n/7 connected-graph bound. Follow-up literature from 2018, 2020 and 2026 did not reveal the triangularized block or the mixed exact-ratio construction. The main residual risk is the 2022 linear-time unicyclic-graph paper, whose full theorem text was not inspected, plus broader survey literature not checked theorem by theorem.

value.summary: The theorem gives a second exact seven-vertex 6/7 block and infinitely many mixed connected equality families over arbitrary connected bases, showing that the proposed equality-side classification is incomplete while leaving the universal upper-bound problem open.

limitations: The universal strong Roman domination upper-bound conjecture gamma_StR(G) <= 6|V(G)|/7 for connected graphs remains open.
The result does not classify all connected graphs with equality.
The full theorem text of the 2022 linear-time unicyclic-graph paper was not inspected and remains the most relevant source of possible partial prior overlap.
Finite enumeration is corroborative and covers connected graphs only through seven vertices.
